subject: Strato Labs: performance runbook + calendar coordination (throughput / SLA rehearsal)
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@stratolabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lin <sophie.lin@stratolabs.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Performance run-through + demo for Strato (throughput & SLAs)

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — Strato's infra team is keen to validate end-to-end characteristics before we commit to a Dedicated capacity purchase. Can we schedule a 90-minute technical rehearsal focused on:

- Sustained token throughput target: ~2.5M tokens/minute (mixed short/long sessions)
- P95 latency SLOs for 512 token requests: <= 120ms
- Failure/fallback behavior (model variant fallback, cold cache)
- Observability walkthrough (dashboards, traces, cost telemetry)

Our target week is Nov 16–20. Preferred timezone: PST mornings. Primary attendees from Strato: myself (platform), Sophie (security). Please let me know available slots and any prerequisites (datasets, API keys, dedicated capacity reservation).

Sample timeline we'd like: 10m intro, 20m baseline smoke, 40m sustained load profile, 15m fallbacks/failures, 5m next steps.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Platform Engineer, Strato Labs
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@stratolabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Performance run-through + demo for Strato (throughput & SLAs)

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the proposed timeline. We can run a full rehearsal and reserve Dedicated capacity for the window. A couple notes / questions before we lock a slot: 

1) Capacity reservation: to safely hit 2.5M tokens/min we'll need to reserve GPU pool X with 6xA100-equivalent nodes for the sustained phase. Can Strato approve an early charge for the reservation? If not, we can run a trimmed rehearsal using burst capacity.

2) Test dataset: please share a representative sample (1000 requests with token length distribution) or confirm we should replay production traces.

3) Observability: we'll provide a temporary shared dashboard link and a Jupyter notebook for post-test analysis.

4) Time slots (PST morning): Nov 17 09:00–10:30, Nov 18 08:30–10:00, Nov 19 09:30–11:00. Tell us which works and we'll send invites and runbook.

I've attached a short loadtest-plan-v2.pdf and runbook-draft.md that outline the phases and rollback steps. Laura — can you shepherd capacity reservation and ask infra to pre-warm cache? Hannah — would you own monitoring dashboard shares?

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

+1 to Markus' plan. A couple operational checklist items I'll run through:

- Procurement: confirm token billing acceptance for the reservation (finance contact on CC if Strato needs PO).
- Network: confirm IP allowlist for the load-generators (we'll provide CIDRs).
- KV cache warm: we'll populate KV cache with top-500 prefixes before the sustained run.
- Canary step: we will do a 5-minute canary at 25% load after the baseline smoke to validate correctness.
- Failure simulations: we will throttle one node and simulate a region-failover; confirm you want that included.

Jordan — quick Q on dataset: if you can upload a 24-hour trace to the Drive folder I linked (or send a subset), we will carve the test profile. If not, we'll synthesize based on the distribution you gave in the demo.

I'll coordinate with infra and reserve the capacity tentatively for Nov 18 08:30–10:00 PST (works for our side) pending Strato confirmation and purchase ok. Hannah, please prepare the dashboard share + alerting snapshot.

Laura Bennett
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Console
